snippet.title: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics | Coming 8th October!
snippet.description:
Step right up, Curators! Take on the role of Funfair Expert, and prepare to reopen the gates of Two Point County’s once-legendary amusement park, after a decades-long hiatus. For years, the site at Riquetti Gardens has sat dark, rusty and guest-less - and there’s nothing amusing about that, hm? 

Your new funfair will boast historic rides from Two Point County’s past, and as our resident Expert, you’ll have the chance to bring history to life for guests by building blueprints for immersive ride experiences that complement your existing museum themes.

Round a corner as you prepare a thrilling adventure for your museum guests, as high-octane engineering meets cultural curation.

Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics arrives 8th October 2026 on PC, XBOX Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, and is coming soon to Nintendo Switch 2.

What’s happening in the park?
- Create your very own personalised coasters across five unique themes.
- Embark on expeditions to the abandoned Gearbox Fairgrounds
- Discover a brand new museum location: Riquetti Gardens
- Unfold a new five-star story campaign
- Collect all ten new mascots, hidden across Expeditions
- Meet a new expert type: Funfair Experts
- Curate over 15 Funfair Exhibits, including the charming Antique Amusements
- Check out with new Gift Shop items
- Discover fresh Funfair-themed items and decorations.
- Landscape with new hedges, fences and outdoor items.
- Enjoy a new range of utility items, such as a Helipad, Ticket Desk, benches, bins, and more!

Play Two Point Museum now on PC, XBOX X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2185060/Two_Point_Museum/
Xbox X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9nfhrf1m4w3z
Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/two-point-museum-explorer-edition-switch-2/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009660
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/two-point-museum-b884ac
